title: "S8 - Sensitivity grid"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S8 (sensitivities).
**Purpose:** report every predeclared one-factor-at-a-time axis around the
baseline, regardless of direction. No axis was added after seeing E1/E2.
**Inputs:** `output/sensitivity_meta.csv`, `output/sensitivity_grid.csv`.
**Outputs:** none.
**Parameters:** the sweep values in `R/config.R`
(`f_irr_sweep`, `cap_mm_sweep`, `q_days_sweep`, `K_days_sweep`).

## Every predeclared axis level must appear

```{r}
sm <- nb_require("sensitivity_meta.csv", "S8")
sg <- nb_require("sensitivity_grid.csv", "S8")
nb_assert_cols(sm, c("axis", "level", "n_gauges", "median_delta_brier",
                     "boot_lo", "boot_hi", "sign_k", "sign_n", "sign_p",
                     "median_delta_auc", "max_p_eq_K"), "sensitivity meta")

expected <- list(
  zero_variant = c("V0", "V2"),
  demand_f_irr = c("0.03", "0.25"),
  supply_variant = c("SUP-2", "SUP-3"),
  intake_cap_mm = c("5", "20"),
  q_days = c("45", "90"),
  K_days = c("180"),
  pet_source = c("Hargreaves"),
  target = c("SPI3_training_only")
)
for (ax in names(expected)) {
  got <- sm[axis == ax, level]
  miss <- setdiff(expected[[ax]], got)
  nb_assert(length(miss) == 0,
            sprintf("axis '%s' is missing level(s): %s", ax,
                    paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
}
nb_assert(sm[axis == "baseline", .N] == 1, "baseline row missing or duplicated")
cat("all predeclared axis levels present\n")
```

## Long results table (all directions reported)

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  sm[, .(axis, level, n_gauges,
         median_dBrier = round(median_delta_brier, 5),
         lo = round(boot_lo, 5), hi = round(boot_hi, 5),
         sign = sprintf("%d/%d", sign_k, sign_n),
         sign_p = round(sign_p, 3),
         median_dAUC = round(median_delta_auc, 3),
         harm = harm_count,
         max_pK = signif(max_p_eq_K, 2))],
  caption = "One-factor-at-a-time sensitivity around the baseline")
```

## Blocking guard across the grid

```{r}
nb_assert(all(sm$max_p_eq_K < P$block_guard),
          "a sensitivity configuration exceeded the blocking guard")
cat(sprintf("max P(Q=K) across all configurations: %.3e\n",
            max(sm$max_p_eq_K, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

`[measurement]` The confirmatory null (if it holds) is checked against every
axis: the sign of `median(Delta_g)` and the AUC contrast are reported for V0
and V2 zero semantics, a low/medium/high irrigated fraction, SUP-1/2/3, the
cap sweep, the threshold sweeps, Hargreaves PET, and the leakage-clean
training-only target. A conclusion that survives only the baseline would not
be reported as robust.
